transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… mostly work stuff. I know it sounds kind of weird, but I keep feeling like people there, and some of the vendors, are tracking what I buy and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. My supervisor showed me reports saying that’s not really happening, but I can’t shake it.
Have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people don’t?

Yeah… sometimes. Not seeing things, really. But I’ll be in the stockroom, or driving back from a vendor meeting, and I hear this guy’s voice like he’s right behind me. He’ll say, like, “Move faster, Scott,” or laugh about what I picked. Then I turn around and… nobody’s there.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep than usual?

Yeah… that happens. There’ll be weeks where I’m only sleeping like three, maybe four hours, and I wake up feeling… wired, like I don’t really need more. Lying there just feels like wasting time when I could be doing something.
During those wired periods, do you feel more important, powerful, or specially talented than usual?

Yeah… I guess so. I’ll start thinking I can see what’s going to hit before anyone else in L.A., like the sneaker market is basically waiting on what I decide. Which sounds dumb saying it, because I’m still just one of the junior buyers.
Do the voice and the feeling that people are tracking you ever happen when you’re not in one of those wired, low-sleep periods?

Yeah… it has. Not all the time, but there was a stretch where I was sleeping more normal, not feeling like I was… running everything, and I still thought people were watching my buys. And I still heard that voice in the stockroom for a few weeks.
Have there been times when you felt really down or depressed and still heard the voice?
I don’t really know. I mean… I’ve had low days, but I’m not sure I can say the voice was happening at the same time. I don’t track it that closely.
Was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing the voice or felt people were tracking you, while you were not unusually energized or depressed?

Yeah… I think so. There was a calmer stretch, like I was sleeping more normal and not feeling all wired or anything, but I still thought people were tracking my buys. And I was still hearing the voice in the stockroom for a few weeks.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had some rough stretches, yeah, but… I don’t know if it was most of the day nearly every day for two weeks. I don’t really keep track like that.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed nearly every day?
I don’t know… maybe? I’ve had times where I felt pretty low for a while, but I can’t say for sure it was every day for two weeks.
Have you ever had a time when you felt depressed nearly every day for two weeks or longer?
I still can’t really say. I’ve felt down for stretches, but whether it was nearly every day for two weeks… I don’t know.
Have the voice or the feeling that people were tracking you lasted for a month or longer altogether?
Yeah… it’s been longer than a month. I guess around ten months, off and on.
Was there ever a full month when the voice or the feeling that people were tracking you was there continuously?
I don’t know if it was, like, every single day straight through. But it’s been going on for a long time… around ten months, off and on.
Was there ever a full month when you heard the voice every day?

I don’t know about every day for a whole month. It happens sometimes… like in the stockroom, or driving back from a vendor meeting. I’ll hear a man’s voice behind me saying stuff like, “Move faster, Scott,” and when I look, nobody’s there.
Was there ever a full month when you believed people were tracking your buys nearly every day?

Yeah… pretty much. I mean, I kept thinking people at work, and some vendors, were watching what I was buying and messing with the launch numbers so I’d look bad. Even when my supervisor showed me the reports didn’t really prove it, I still couldn’t shake it.
Over the time since these problems started, have the wired, low-sleep periods taken up most of that time?

Yeah… I think so. Looking back, it feels like most of it’s been those wired, irritable stretches where I’m working too much and feel like I know better than everyone. There were calmer times, but they didn’t last as long.
